about: What this sketch itself asserts, with how sure it is. Confidence: high, medium, low.

assertions.text: The cover is visible from Sentinel-2 at 10 m.
assertions.basis: A bright strip along the ski run in every late-summer scene 2016-2026 (filmstrip).
assertions.limit: Presence is clear; shape details at 10 m are not.

assertions.text: Fleece and clean ice differ in shortwave infrared (fleece reflects, ice absorbs).
assertions.basis: Two sample areas per surface, one date: fleece 37-47%, ice 3-4% at 1.6 um.
assertions.limit: Two areas, one date; sheets age and get dirty.

assertions.text: The covered area can be bounded year by year from 2016 (lower / best / upper).
assertions.basis: Spectral unmixing with five reference surfaces; fleece found outside the ski run reported as error.
assertions.limit: Not validated against independent images; dirty snow and covers outside the zone inflate the error in some years.

assertions.text: The melt model reproduces the field result of 52-69% less melt.
assertions.limit: Albedos now from field measurements (0.64 new fleece, 0.43 glacier and reused fleece, AINEVA 2010 and thesis 2012); weather reanalysed for 2021 only.

assertions.text: The standard cloud mask (s2cloudless) mistakes the fleece for cloud.
assertions.basis: 14 Aug 2021, a clear day: 0.26% cloud on a ring around the ski run, 11.1% on the ski run itself.
assertions.limit: One clear day checked; the effect on other dates is inferred from the missing 2021 scene.
